facts.text: Through Dominican University's No Out-of-Pocket Promise, commuting Chicago campus students who qualify for the full Pell Grant and Illinois MAP Grant have their tuition and mandatory fees fully covered.

sources.title: Chicago Campus - Dominican University
sources.quote: Through our No Out-of-Pocket Promise, students who commute to the Chicago campus and qualify for the full Pell Grant and Illinois MAP Grant* will have their tuition and mandatory fees fully covered, resulting in no out-of-pocket cost.
